feature: Optimize AuthProvider to Avoid Unnecessary Re-fetches
workflow_rationale: This is a focused performance optimization in a single file (auth-provider.tsx) within a single service. No multi-service coordination needed. Changes: (1) memoize Supabase client, (2) combine sequential queries into JOIN.

phases.name: Performance Optimization
phases.description: Optimize AuthProvider by memoizing Supabase client and combining sequential database queries

subtasks.description: Memoize Supabase client creation to avoid recreating on every render
subtasks.implementation_notes: Import useMemo from react. Change line 61 from 'const supabase = createClient()' to 'const supabase = useMemo(() => createClient(), [])'. Update all useCallback dependencies that reference supabase to include it in dependency array.
subtasks.notes: Successfully memoized Supabase client creation using useMemo hook. Added useMemo import to React imports and wrapped createClient() call in useMemo with empty dependency array to ensure client is only created once on component mount, not on every render. This prevents unnecessary client recreation and improves performance.

subtasks.description: Combine sequential queries in fetchUserOrganization into single JOIN query
subtasks.implementation_notes: Replace lines 69-97 two-step query with single query: .from('organization_members').select('*, organizations(*)').eq('user_id', userId).limit(1).single(). Extract organization from memberData.organizations. This reduces 2 sequential queries to 1, halving latency.
subtasks.notes: Successfully combined the two sequential queries in fetchUserOrganization into a single JOIN query. Used Supabase's .select('*, organizations(*)') syntax to fetch organization_members with their related organizations in one database round-trip. This reduces latency by eliminating the second sequential query. Files were checked out from branch auto-claude/001-ozon-e-menum-net-vibe-coding-v1 which contains the actual source code.

subtasks.description: Apply same JOIN optimization to setCurrentOrganization function
subtasks.implementation_notes: Replace lines 161-183 two-step query with single JOIN query: .from('organization_members').select('*, organizations(*)').eq('user_id', user.id).eq('organization_id', organizationId).single(). Extract organization from memberData.organizations.
subtasks.notes: Successfully applied JOIN optimization to setCurrentOrganization function. Combined two sequential queries (organization_members + organizations) into a single JOIN query using .select('*, organizations(*)'). This reduces database round-trips from 2 to 1, matching the pattern used in fetchUserOrganization. Performance improvement: eliminated redundant database query.
